```{r}
#| label: set-up-results
#| echo: false
library(targets)
library(tarchetypes)
library(gt)

targets::tar_config_set(store = here::here("_targets"))
source(here::here("R/functions/tidymodels.r"))
```

## Results

### PART 1: Whole community analysis

### Functional group richness effect

Test overall effects of number of functional groups (functional group richness) on standing biomass across the climate grid. Functional group richness increases standing biomass (@fig-fg-richness-effects, @tbl-fg-richness-tidy-table). There are no interactive effects, and temperature and precipitation alone have no effect on standing biomass.

```{r}
#| label: fig-fg-richness-effects
#| fig-cap: "Estimated effects from the mixed-effects model of number of functional groups on standing biomass. The model coefficients with confidence intervals for functional group richness, precipitation, and temperature and their interactions are shown."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

tar_read(fig_fg_richness_effects)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fg-richness-tidy-table
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Load the tidy model output for fg_richness
tar_load(fg_richness_tidy)

pretty_model_table(fg_richness_tidy)

```

### Functional group identity effects

Functional group identity effects on standing biomass (@fig-fg-identity-interactions, @tbl-fg-identity-tidy-table). Standing biomass decreases at warmer sites when forbs are removed. Standing biomass increases at wetter sites when forbs or graminoids are removed.

```{r}
#| label: fig-fg-identity-interactions
#| fig-cap: "Interaction effects from the mixed-effects model for functional group identity on standing biomass. The plot displays estimated interaction effects between functional group identity and environmental variables."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Load the figure from targets
tar_read(fig_fg_identity_interactions)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fg-identity-tidy-table
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Load the tidy model output for fg_identity
if (!exists("fg_identity_tidy")) tar_load(fg_identity_tidy)

pretty_model_table(fg_identity_tidy)
```

### Functional group removed (factorial)

-   Total standing biomass decreases when graminoids in combination with forbs or bryophytes are removed. There is a trend for F:B.

-   Biomass also decreases in wetter places when bryophytes are removed.

-   Contrasts show that when bryophytes or more than two functional groups are removed, total biomass decreases.

```{r}
#| label: fig-results-total-biomass
#| fig-cap: "Biomass varies with temperature"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# load in figure
tar_read(fig_total_biomass_treatment_temperature)

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-results-total-biomass-model
#| tbl-cap: "Fixed-effect estimates from the total standing biomass model (factorial functional group removals and climate)."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

tar_load(total_comp_model_results)

total_comp_model_results |>
  mutate(p.value = format.pval(p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    term = "Model term",
    estimate = "Estimate",
    std.error = "SE",
    conf.low = "Lower 95% CI",
    conf.high = "Upper 95% CI",
    p.value = md("*p*-value")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      rows = total_comp_model_results$p.value < 0.05
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = cells_body(
      rows = total_comp_model_results$p.value >= 0.05 &
        total_comp_model_results$p.value <= 0.07
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-results-total-biomass-contrasts
#| tbl-cap: "Model results for the total biomass model"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

tar_load(total_comp_contrasts_mean_climate_table)

total_comp_contrasts_mean_climate_table
```
